parole.significato: a North Macedonian; a person from or inhabitant of North Macedonia
parole.testo: From Nord-Makedonia (“North Macedonia”) + -er (“demonym-forming suffix”), with loss of the final -ia. The country name is from Nord- (“north”) + Makedonia (“Macedonia”). The second element is ultimately from Ancient Greek Μᾰκεδονῐ́ᾱ (Măkedonĭ́ā, “Macedonia”), from Μᾰκεδών (Măkedṓn, “a Macedonian”) a
